## Introduction

**URL:** https://docs.example.com/docs
**Description:** PurePay - Global Payment Network

**PurePay** is a mobile app for sending and receiving payments directly between people.
These docs explain how to set up the app, make payments, and manage your profile.

  

## What you can do with PurePay

- Send and receive payments
- Keep a verifiable history of every payment
- Manage your profile and the details you share

## Need help?

If something in these docs is unclear or missing, contact the PurePay team.

---

## Quickstart

**URL:** https://docs.example.com/docs/quickstart
**Description:** Send your first payment with PurePay

This guide assumes you have finished [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started) and your profile is approved.

## Send a payment

```mermaid
flowchart LR
	A[INIT]:::state
	B(PENDING):::state
	C([ACTIVE]):::state
	D([ACCEPTED]):::state
    E([REJECTED]):::state
    A <--> B
    B -- Certifies a lot --> C
    A --> C
    C -->D
    C-->E
```

  
  

## Receive a payment

Show your QR code to the person paying you, or share your profile with them.
